_note: Measurement register. Every value lists each reading, the photo, the reference used and the method. Photos are third-party and are linked, not stored. See docs/METHOD.md.

mat_grid.what: A3 self-healing cutting mat, 1 cm printed grid, 0-42 x 0-27 cm rulers, labelled circles 10-29 mm
mat_grid.status: printed scale; homography residual 0.16-0.39 mm RMS over 351-631 grid crossings

hose_6mm.what: Hasbro stock red and blue hoses, 6 mm

head_length_ansur2.what: Adult head length (glabella to back of head), ANSUR II 2012 US Army survey
head_length_ansur2.source: The Ergonomics Center of North Carolina, Anthropometric Summary Data Tables (2017), citing Gordon et al. 2014 (ANSUR II)
head_length_ansur2.note: +3 mm allowed for short hair in photos

readings.method: focal minimising circle-fit residual of the cake rim

cake_top_diameter_mm.method: radial silhouette (508 of 716 rays kept), mapped to the plane of the cake top through the calibrated camera, robust circle fit; residual SD 0.08 mm
cake_top_diameter_mm.uncertainty: dominated by the cake height (41-53 mm); focal 1400-1442 changes D by < 1 mm

cake_height_mm.method: near-side top rim (y=1015) and base on mat (y=1177) at x=946; camera from mat homography (64 crossings, RMS 0.52 mm); height range spans focal 1500-1850

cyclotron_rear_panel_outer_diameter_mm.method: 8 edge points read at 3x zoom on the left, right and top arcs, mapped to the mat through the calibrated camera (z 0-6 mm), circle fit; residuals within 1.1 mm

img1_red_hose_width_px.method: half-maximum edges on the red channel, 5 parallel profiles per point

img1_scale_mm_per_px.status: REJECTED as primary scale: implies 874 mm front height, against 570-640 mm from two worn-pack photos scaled by head length. The measured red tubes are probably not the 6 mm hoses gbrich refers to (or 6 mm is not their size).

img3_worn_side.head_points: glabella x=1247 (y~220), back of head x~892
img3_worn_side.depth_correction: board's near edge ~170 mm closer to camera than the head's midline; /1.04-1.08 for camera 2.5-4 m

img2_worn_back.head_points: glabella x~712, back of head x~1087
img2_worn_back.pack_points: shell top y~409 to lid bottom y~1636
img2_worn_back.depth_correction: pack front ~350 mm closer than head midline; factor 1.10-1.16 for camera 2.5-4 m

img1_front_height_px.points: gearbox top edge y=131 to bottom of the lower lid disc y~1835

open_issues: Overall height ~655 mm (640-680), frame-based. A tape measurement of a 1984 pack (or of gbrich's Rothco frame) is needed for +/-1%.
Head-length scaling of the worn photos (590-595 mm) disagrees; unexplained.
Identify which tubes on the 1984 pack are the 6 mm hoses gbrich refers to (post #4).

anchors.anchor: Crank knob, MS91528 replica, 1-1/4 in (31.75 mm)
anchors.method: circle fit to 291 edge points, residual SD 0.34 px

anchors.anchor: Thin red tube from elbow, 5/32 in (3.97 mm) on screen packs
Thick red hose at strain relief, 6 mm
Blue hose to ion-arm elbow, 1/4 in (6.35 mm) on screen packs

anchors.source: ANSUR II via Ergonomics Center of NC
ANSUR II via Ergonomics Center of NC

scale_crosscheck_img1_superseded.status: SUPERSEDED 2026-11-03: these anchors give the horizontal scale of image 1 correctly, but image 1 is shot from above with the pack leaning back, so vertical distances are foreshortened by k = 0.91. Implied heights below are uncorrected; divide by k.
scale_crosscheck_img1_superseded.excluded: none yet; the 1/4 in blue hose (672 mm) is the high outlier and the 6 mm thick hose (547 mm) the low one

overall_height.status: estimated; all three in-scope measurements use the Rothco frame's listed size, which limits accuracy to about +/-3%
overall_height.definition: motherboard top to bottom edge in the straight-on back view (image 9); the front view's gearbox top to lower disc spans the same height within about 2%

readings.method: unlit upper-left cyclotron lens, ellipse fit to red mask: 84.9 x 93.3 px (h x w)
silver end cap of the bumper's copper knob, ellipse fit: 75.0 x 87.9 px (h x w)

foreshortening_img1.rejected_reading: v0.4 draft used image-1 shell width (932 px) against image-9 board width; invalid, because the image-1 width includes the power-cell box and the image-9 width mixed board sections
foreshortening_img1.consequence: the 590 mm front height of v0.3 was image-1 pixel height times a horizontal scale; it is low by 1/k

anchors.anchor: Rothco frame width 318 mm vs board outline ratios (image 9): frame sits inside the upper section (ratio 0.494) and overhangs the lower section (0.454) in post #68 photos

excluded_out_of_scope.anchor: Shoulder strap webbing, image 9: 101.5 px; assumed 1.5 in (38.1 mm), the usual size for this buckle style
excluded_out_of_scope.why: webbing sizes ambiguous: strap/belt ratio 1.251 matches no standard pair (1.5/2 in = 1.333, 1.25/1.5 in = 1.200)

excluded_out_of_scope.anchor: Waist belt webbing, image 9: 127 px; assumed 2 in (50.8 mm); belt ~40 mm proud of the board, -2.5%
excluded_out_of_scope.why: webbing sizes ambiguous: strap/belt ratio 1.251 matches no standard pair (1.5/2 in = 1.333, 1.25/1.5 in = 1.200)

excluded_out_of_scope.anchor: Redman Studio Workshop aluminium motherboard for the HasLab pack, 'approx. 15 x 27 x 1/8 in'; gbrich fitted this board to the Hasbro 1984 pack (posts #1, #68)
Rothco LC-1 ALICE frame '20.5 x 12.5 in' (gbrich's frame, post #72) lying on the Redman board, post #68 photo; length via the side tubes' vanishing point
HasLab Spengler pack shipping box 26.75 x 14.57 in (Shacknews unboxing)

overall_height.conflict: head-length scaling of Hasbro's worn photos (590-595 mm; plausible 560-640 given unknown camera distance) disagrees; unexplained

limits: Rothco frame size is a listed (shipping) figure, accuracy unknown, ~+/-2-4%
every whole-pack photo of the 1984 pack is either perspective-uncontrolled (front, worn) or has no measured in-plane reference (straight-on back)

gbrich's mat-measured parts (rear panel 262 mm +/-0.8%, cake 141 mm +/-2%) sit inside the cyclotron, ~50-200 mm in front of the board, and are never in the same plane as the board's top and bottom edges in a calibrated photo
what_reaches_it: tape or rule on a 1984 pack's motherboard, top to bottom and across the three sections (+/-1-2 mm)
a photo of the board square to the camera with a tape or the A3 cutting mat lying on it (homography, +/-0.5%)
a caliper/tape measurement of gbrich's Rothco frame, which would turn the three frame-based estimates into +/-1-1.5%

checks: Rothco frame 318 mm: wider than lower section, narrower than upper section; matches post #68 photos (tubes overhang the lower board, sit inside it at the top)
motherboard_outline.supersedes: v0.4 draft 'motherboard width 326 mm', which mixed board sections

_scope: Hasbro 1984 Proton Pack (G19145L00) only. Film-prop part sizes, other packs (HasLab Spengler/Afterlife, Spirit) and aftermarket listings for other packs are not used as dimensional references (owner instruction, 2026-11-03).
